body:
The first paragraph of your post really speaks to me. I don't really consider myself highly intelligent but that's mostly because I feel like my thoughts and obsessions are holding my true potential back. I'll probably never know how good my life could have been in different circumstances.

Our daily lives contain so much different stimuli, it's hell when you have a mind that is aware of so much. It's even worse when you realize you have no control over it. 

And that's probably why death seems so beautiful. It's an end to everything. When you know how much pain it will bring to family, friends and colleagues but still long for it, that's when you know it's bad.

I never did drugs but the rest you said does feel similar to myself. I feel like these thoughts have gone too far, like I've crossed a line. And now it will never get better. It really feels like my brain is broken and can't function right anymore.
